== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Vehicle Mine (Dark) (Japanese)|Vehicle Mine (Dark)]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/159563449/sTpW0gLFXk-wQ9heE8zqng.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 159563449.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>fe9342d22fec07a452192236ce0cb8aed260ad6ea9d1b2f3b7c3d869dabd1024</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
